title: Paratmos
description: Paratmos: model-driven working for organisations with complex data. One canonical model as the source, and from it the interfaces, the register and the documentation.

config.tekst: Concrete, applicable and thorough: one model for the data, the processes and the rules of your organisation.

config.kop: The basis: processes, data and rules
config.intro: Together these three carry the whole functioning of an organisation. Around them lie vision, goals and services, customers and chain partners, and what comes from outside.

gegevens.tekst: What the organisation knows and records.

processen.tekst: What happens, in what order and by whom.

regels.tekst: What is allowed and what is required.

config.kop: One model. The rest follows from it.
config.intro: From the model follow the interfaces, the register, the requirements and the documentation.

afgeleiden.label: OpenAPI · XSD
afgeleiden.tekst: Messages and APIs that say the same as the model, because they come from it.

afgeleiden.label: SQL
afgeleiden.tekst: A schema that gets history, correction and repair right from the start.

afgeleiden.label: BPMN · use cases
afgeleiden.tekst: What happens to the data, in the same concepts as the model.

afgeleiden.label: A0
afgeleiden.tekst: From the reference for developers to the poster on the wall for the business.

items.title: An organisation-wide data model
items.markdown: A logical model of all data, its meaning and its coherence, independent of the systems it lives in today.

items.title: Analysis and requirements
items.markdown: From legislation and wishes to use cases, impact analyses and backlog items a team can build with.

items.title: Training and coaching
items.markdown: UML, SysML, BPMN, requirements (IREB) and OCEB, and coaching a group of analysts on method.

items.title: Tooling
items.markdown: Setting up your modelling environment in Sparx Enterprise Architect or Bizzdesign, and Omnium as a workbench for a proof of concept.

config.title: Now: Common Ground
config.markdown: For VNG, the association of Dutch municipalities, I work on Common Ground: the bitemporal register, the municipal data model, federated access control and the question of how APIs deal with history.

config.title: Before: the trade register
config.markdown: For the KVK, the Dutch Chamber of Commerce, I made the logical model of the entire trade register, with the interfaces and the design for correction and repair.

config.title: Blog and knowledge base
config.markdown: The blog and the knowledge base on modelling, time in data and Dutch government standards are written in Dutch.

config.title: Shall we talk?
config.markdown: A one-hour conversation is usually enough to see whether and where a model will help you.
